name: Imperfect Women
s: Based on Araminta Hall's novel of the same name, Imperfect Women is an unconventional, psychological thriller about a crime that shatters the lives of a decades-long friendship of three women. As the investigation unravels, so does the truth about how even the closest relationships can change over time.

paragraphs.text: Imperfect Women is a psychological thriller television series starring Kerry Washington, Joel Kinnaman, Elisabeth Moss, Kate Mara, and Corey Stoll. Created by Annie Weisman, the series is an adaptation of Araminta Hall's 2020 novel Imperfect Women. It premiered on Apple TV on March18, 2026. In October 2026, Apple TV renewed the series for a second season.

A devastating crime has an impact on a decades-long friendship of three women. As Eleanor (Kerry Washington) and Mary (Elisabeth Moss) process their grief and help the police investigate Nancy's (Kate Mara) murder, the investigation unravels a dark web of secrets.

The series holds a 43% approval rating on review aggregator Rotten Tomatoes, based on 46 critic reviews with an average rating of 5.9/10. The website's critics consensus reads, "A powerhouse trio isn't enough to save a middling narrative that lacks originality, pizzazz, and a sustainable conceit." Metacritic, which uses a weighted average, assigned a score of 54 out of 100 based on 20 critics, indicating "mixed or average".
